category.instructions: Which existing budget category best describes this Walmart product? Use ABSTAIN when the product is unclear, mixed, a fee, or no category fits. Classify the product's intended use, not its brand.

criteria.Groceries: Food and drinks for people, including coffee and adult nutrition shakes; not infant formula
criteria.Pet food: Animal food and edible pet treats
criteria.Pet supplies: Non-food animal care, litter, pet shampoo, leads and training pads
criteria.Cleaning supplies: Cleaning dishes, surfaces, trash handling and household odor control
criteria.Laundry: Washing clothes, fabric softener and dryer sheets
criteria.Paper goods: Disposable toilet paper, paper towels, napkins and paper plates
criteria.Personal care: Human hygiene, soap, toothpaste, hand sanitizer and cotton swabs
criteria.Baby care: Diapers, baby wipes and infant formula
criteria.Kitchen equipment: Reusable cookware, utensils and kitchen tools
criteria.Home furnishings: Bedding, curtains, pillows and home furnishings
criteria.Electronics: Electronic accessories, charging cables and batteries
criteria.ABSTAIN: Insufficient information, ambiguous purpose, mixed categories, fees, gift cards or no matching category
